p.title: v59.97 The news bear keyword '위기' no longer matches inside '분위기'
p.symptom: A headline such as '연말 랠리 분위기, 코스피 강세' was classified warn and pulled the day's news tone toward bearish.
p.root_cause: Multi-character Korean keywords match as plain substrings in keyword-match.js, so the bear keyword '위기' (crisis) hit inside '분위기' (mood).
p.fix: keyword-match.js carries a small exclusion table for substring keywords ({ '위기': ['분위기'] }); a substring hit counts only when it is not part of an excluded word at that position. The compiled matcher stays cached per keyword.
p.violated_rule: One keyword rule for every news list must not produce false matches inside unrelated words.
p.prevention: ci-esm-core-unit-check: '투자 분위기 살아나' misses '위기'; '금융 위기 우려' and '위기감 확산' hit; the stance of '연말 랠리 분위기, 코스피 강세' is not warn.
p.verification: node scripts/ci-esm-core-unit-check.mjs failed on the old source and passes now; architecture, runtime, native-decision-evidence, domain-parity, data-pipeline and expect-output gates exit 0 (no news-selection fixture output changed).

changelog: **Mood is not crisis ({P}):** the news tone no longer counts '분위기' (mood) as the bear keyword '위기' (crisis); the keyword matcher now skips a Korean keyword inside a listed longer word.
note: v59.97: substring keyword exclusion table, '위기' not inside '분위기'
